templateAuthor.optionMedia.limit.en: Use at most 500 UTF-16 units per reference and 2,000 for all attachment data. This edit was not applied.
templateAuthor.optionMedia.limit.zh-Hans: 每个地址最多 500 个 UTF-16 单元，全部附件数据最多 2,000 个。本次修改未应用。

templateAuthor.optionMedia.scope.en: Image and audio references stay attached to choices A–D. These fields do not upload, fetch, or play media.
templateAuthor.optionMedia.scope.zh-Hans: 图片和音频地址按 A–D 选项保存。此处不上传、加载或播放媒体。

templateAuthor.optionMedia.unsupported.en: This saved attachment data has an unsupported format. It is preserved unchanged and cannot be edited here.
templateAuthor.optionMedia.unsupported.zh-Hans: 已保存的附件数据格式暂不支持。原数据保持不变，此处无法编辑。
